en-US.title: OptiScan Pro X1 Inline AOI System
en-US.summary: High-speed 3D automated optical inspection module engineered for high-density PCB and semiconductor packaging lines.
en-US.short_answer: OptiScan Pro X1 is an inline 3D AOI system delivering 0.5-micron height resolution and up to 65 sq.cm/sec inspection speed for SMT production lines.
en-US.content: Designed for zero-defect electronics manufacturing, the OptiScan Pro X1 combines multi-phase structured light projection with telecentric optics to eliminate shadow blind spots on dense assemblies.
en-US.seo_title: OptiScan Pro X1 Inline 3D AOI System | PrecisionTech
en-US.seo_description: Sub-micron inline 3D automated optical inspection system with IPC-CFX integration for high-density electronics manufacturing.

zh-CN.title: OptiScan Pro X1 在线式 3D AOI 光学检测系统
zh-CN.summary: 面向高密度电路板与先进封装产线的高速三维自动光学检测模组，兼顾亚微米高度复原与高直通率。
zh-CN.short_answer: OptiScan Pro X1 是一款在线 3D AOI 检测系统，具备 0.5 微米高度解析度与每秒 65 平方厘米的检测速度，支持 IPC-CFX 协议。
zh-CN.content: 针对高可靠性电子制造场景设计，采用多相位结构光投影与远心光学镜头组合，消除高元件遮挡阴影盲区。
zh-CN.seo_title: OptiScan Pro X1 在线 3D AOI 检测系统 | 精工智测
zh-CN.seo_description: 高密度贴装与先进封装在线式三维自动光学检测系统，支持 IPC-CFX 智能工厂互联。

en-US.title: MicroLink Linear Motor Motion Stage
en-US.summary: Ironless direct-drive linear stage offering ultra-low velocity ripple for laser micromachining and wafer metrology.
en-US.short_answer: MicroLink PT-STG-400 is a direct-drive linear motor stage featuring +/-0.4 um bidirectional repeatability and ironless zero-cogging dynamics.
en-US.content: Built on a stress-relieved granite or hard-anodized aluminum base, MicroLink stages integrate optical linear encoders for maintenance-free 24/7 cleanroom operation.
en-US.seo_description: Zero-cogging linear motor positioning stage engineered for wafer metrology, photonics alignment, and laser processing.

zh-CN.title: MicroLink 无铁芯直驱直线电机精密平台
zh-CN.summary: 零齿槽效应直驱运动平台，适用于晶圆量测、光子耦合对准与精密激光微加工。
zh-CN.short_answer: MicroLink PT-STG-400 采用无铁芯直驱电机与高分辨率光栅尺，实现 +/-0.4 微米双向重复定位精度，满足洁净室全天候运行。
zh-CN.content: 平台底座采用航空硬质阳极氧化铝或天然花岗岩结构，具备极低的速度波动率与免维护高寿命表现。
zh-CN.seo_title: MicroLink 精密直驱直线电机平台 | 精工智测
zh-CN.seo_description: 面向半导体量测与激光微加工的零齿槽效应直驱运动平台，双向重复定位精度达 0.4 微米。
